meta.source: Thorncliffe Park Community Hub logo; Sprout Climate deck (Sept 9, 2026); Sprout Strategic Plan 2025-2030; official Sprout logo
meta.decisions: Screen tokens (app-*, type groups 'Screens: …', line heights) record the design owner's decisions G1–G10 of 2026-10-02. Rare spacing values and where they are used: docs/design-framework/spacing-container/rare-spacing-inventory.md.

tokens.name: tpch-orange
tokens.usage: Hub orange, sampled from the Thorncliffe Park Community Hub logo. Identity fill; carries the urban heat topic through `topic-heat`. Text only at 36px+ (3.2:1 on `surface`). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: tpch-blue
tokens.usage: Hub blue, from the logo. Identity fill; carries flooding through `topic-flood`. Readable as text on light grounds (4.7:1 on `surface`), not on navy (3.0:1).

tokens.name: tpch-yellow
tokens.usage: Hub yellow, from the logo. Accent bars, buttons, and the wellbeing topic. Never text on light grounds (1.8:1); text on it is `on-yellow`.

tokens.name: tpch-green
tokens.usage: Hub green, from the logo. Identity fill; carries food security through `topic-food`. Not for text on light grounds (3.3:1).

tokens.name: topic-heat
tokens.usage: Urban heat (apartments without AC, no shade). The top bar, tag stripe or notice strip of anything about heat. Never decoration.

tokens.name: topic-flood
tokens.usage: Flooding (basement floods, car parks underwater). Same use as `topic-heat`.

tokens.name: topic-food
tokens.usage: Food security (rising costs, food banks under pressure). Same use as `topic-heat`.

tokens.name: topic-wellbeing
tokens.usage: Wellbeing (climate anxiety, isolation in extreme weather). Same use as `topic-heat`.

tokens.name: sprout-green
tokens.usage: Sprout green, from the official Sprout logo. Only on Sprout marks and the document footer mark; never a fifth topic colour. 4.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: yellow-tint
tokens.usage: Pale yellow from the strategic plan's topic tags. Icon discs and light tags, with `on-yellow` text (13:1). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is the strategic plan's page grey; Navy is Sprout navy, for covers, section breaks and closing slides.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and notices, one step above `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Navy panels, page headers and bands inside a light page. Pair with `on-deep`.

tokens.name: surface-warm
tokens.usage: Cream fill of ServiceCards (strategic plan). Stays cream in both themes; text on it is `on-yellow` and `text-on-warm`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines. Decorative (2.1:1 on navy); a control's edge uses `control-border`.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox edges (5.3:1 on `surface`, 8.2:1 on navy).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, card titles, icons. 14.2:1 on `surface`, 14:1 on navy.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on `surface` and `surface-raised` (16.7:1; Navy 12.1:1 and 8.8:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, helper text, captions, page counters. 5.3:1 on `surface`; Navy 8.2:1 on `surface`, 5.9:1 on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: text-on-warm
tokens.usage: Body copy inside `surface-warm` and `yellow-tint` (15:1), both themes.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text, rules and tag outlines on `surface-deep` (14:1 light, 16:1 Navy).

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `tpch-yellow` (8.1:1) and `yellow-tint` (13:1).

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: The optional sentence-case label above a section title, at most one per three sections. Light: darkened Hub green (5.2:1); Navy: Hub yellow (8.1:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links. Light: Hub blue (4.7:1 on `surface`); Navy: Hub yellow (8.1:1).

tokens.name: numeral
tokens.usage: Step numbers in Steps, at 36px+ only, and only when order matters. Light 3.2:1 (large text); Navy 8.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-bar
tokens.usage: The 10px bar on panels and callouts and the 48 by 4 short rule. Decorative.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the error edge of a Field (6.3:1 on `surface`; Navy 8:1). Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset. Blue on light grounds (4.7:1), yellow on navy (8.1:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed backdrop behind a modal panel (the Hub menu drawer; the prototype's .cvh-overlay). Decorative; the same in both themes.

launch.usage: Pilot screens launch in the light theme. Navy is generated for every colour token, but the pilot ships no theme selector (G9).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Cover and closing titles, on navy. Two lines at most.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slide title in `ink`. A plain statement; a full stop is fine.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: The line under a title or cover name, in `text` or `text-muted`. Same weight and colour family as the page, never italic accent.
styles.sample: Communities ready for what comes next.

styles.name: card-title-sm
styles.usage: Titles in feature cards and steps.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Shift the paradigm from consultation to co-creation.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy under card titles. Keep lines under 65 characters.
styles.sample: Basement floods. Car parks underwater after storms.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Sign at the Toronto Youth Climate March

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Optional section label in `eyebrow`, sentence case. At most one per three sections.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Running text and inputs. Lines under 75 characters.
styles.sample: Communities already hold the knowledge, relationships, and drive to create change.

styles.name: doc-body-sm
styles.usage: Card copy, helper and error text.
styles.sample: Turning numbers into narratives that move people and open doors.

styles.name: doc-cta
styles.usage: Button labels, one to three words.

styles.name: screen-alert
styles.usage: Alert action and alert body lines.

styles.name: screen-lead
styles.usage: Lead line under a title; option labels.

styles.name: screen-basic-alert
styles.usage: Alert action and alert body lines.

styles.name: screen-basic-lead
styles.usage: Lead line under a title; option labels.

styles.name: screen-staff-alert
styles.usage: Alert action and alert body lines.

styles.name: screen-staff-lead
styles.usage: Lead line under a title; option labels.

lineHeights.name: lh-tight
lineHeights.usage: Default line height of headings and tight labels (G10).

lineHeights.name: lh-body-staff
lineHeights.usage: Body line height on Hub and ambassador screens (G10). Arabic-script text (ur, ps, prs) overrides it with lh-body-arabic on staff screens; Indic and Chinese text keep it.

lineHeights.name: lh-body-arabic
lineHeights.usage: Arabic-script body (G10). Applies on resident and staff screens, and overrides lh-body-staff.

lineHeights.name: lh-tight-arabic
lineHeights.usage: Arabic-script headings (G10). Applies on resident and staff screens.

lineHeights.name: lh-body-chinese
lineHeights.usage: Chinese body, Simplified and Traditional; headings use lh-tight (G10).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Short rule thickness; gap between label and input. Slides and documents only; not generated for the app (G1).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Accent bar thickness; icon-to-label gap. Slides and documents only; not generated for the app (G1).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gutter inside a card grid. Slides and documents only; not generated for the app (G1).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutter between panels; paragraph gap. Slides and documents only; not generated for the app (G1). Screen cards use app-space-8 (G6).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on slides. Slides and documents only; not generated for the app (G1).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Outer margin of card rows; the short rule's length. Slides and documents only; not generated for the app (G1).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page inset for title blocks on slides. Slides and documents only; not generated for the app (G1).

app.name: app-space-2
app.usage: Label to its control; small stacked lines; row gap of list-row metadata.

app.name: app-space-4
app.usage: Related items in a row or list; minimum space between two separate controls.

app.name: app-space-5
app.usage: Icon to label; tiles in a grid; gap of equal-column blocks inside a Hub page (O-06, O-12).

app.name: app-space-6
app.usage: Default stack gap; compact card padding.

app.name: app-space-7
app.usage: Component-specific card padding; row gap of the disruption type grid (X-13).

app.name: app-space-8
app.usage: Resident gutter (inline and top); resident section gap; default card padding; Hub inset below the Hub breakpoint.

app.name: app-space-9
app.usage: Hub section gap; stacked gap of a collapsed two-column Hub page.

app.name: app-space-10
app.usage: Resident screen bottom inset; Hub page inset; gap between panels and two-column Hub pages that use 24.

app.name: app-space-1px
app.usage: Optical alignment of a check box or small icon with the first text line.
locations: cvh.css:488 .cvh-option__box margin-block-start (A-02, A-04, O-02, O-03, O-04, O-05, O-07, O-11, O-15, O-18, R-05, R-26, R-33, R-35)

app.name: app-space-3px
app.usage: Optical alignment of an icon with the first line of body text.

app.name: app-space-7px
app.usage: Inline padding of the Hub side navigation count badge.

app.name: app-space-18px
app.usage: Inline padding of large resident buttons; Hub review page sections; list-row metadata; disruption type grid.
locations: cvh.css:153 .cvh-dest padding-inline (R-03, R-07, R-11, R-12, R-14, R-16, R-24, R-25)
O07_AmbReview.dc.html:72 and O12_AckComposer.dc.html:90 main-column section stack

app.name: app-space-22px
app.usage: Main-column section stack on Hub compose and audience pages.

app.name: app-space-28px
app.usage: Gap between the main column and the 380px aside on two-column Hub pages.

tokens.name: app-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target of every control (G3). Inline links inside text are exempt.

tokens.name: app-tap-basic
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in basic mode (G3).

tokens.name: app-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon, resident screens (G7).

tokens.name: app-icon-basic
tokens.usage: Default icon in basic mode (G7).

tokens.name: app-icon-staff
tokens.usage: Default icon on Hub and ambassador screens (G7).

tokens.name: app-logo-hub
tokens.usage: Block size of the Hub logo in the Hub side navigation and menu drawer (the prototype's .cvh-side__logo).

tokens.name: app-symbol-hub
tokens.usage: Block size of the Hub symbol in the top bar on a phone (C_HubTop). A brand mark, not an icon, so it does not follow the icon size.

tokens.name: app-min-header-resident
tokens.usage: Minimum block size of the resident header; grows with translated text (G8). The prototype's earlier 60px declaration is overridden by 56px.

tokens.name: app-max-actions
tokens.usage: Maximum block size of a screen's sticky actions region (the prototype's .cvh-pubbar); taller wrapped labels scroll inside it, so it stays pinned at the block end of the viewport.

tokens.name: app-min-topbar-hub
tokens.usage: Minimum block size of the Hub top bar; grows with translated text (G8).

tokens.name: app-min-nav-item-resident
tokens.usage: Minimum block size of a resident navigation item; grows with translated text (G8).

tokens.name: app-min-nav-item-resident-basic
tokens.usage: Minimum block size of a resident navigation item in basic mode (G8).

tokens.name: app-page-staff
tokens.usage: Default maximum inline size of a Hub page, used where no screen-specific maximum exists (G5).

tokens.name: app-page-staff-review
tokens.usage: Maximum inline size of Hub compose, audience, pre-send, ambassador review and promote pages, which already use it: O-02, O-03, O-04, O-05, O-07, O-13 (G5).

tokens.name: app-page-staff-partner
tokens.usage: Maximum inline size of partner-space pages, which already use it: P-01..P-16, MVP scope (G5).

tokens.name: app-page-staff-published
tokens.usage: Maximum inline size of the Hub page that already uses it: O-06. Preserved from the approved prototype (G5).

tokens.name: app-page-staff-log
tokens.usage: Maximum inline size of the Hub page that already uses it: O-11. Preserved from the approved prototype (G5).

tokens.name: app-page-staff-update
tokens.usage: Maximum inline size of the Hub page that already uses it: O-14, O-15. Preserved from the approved prototype (G5).

tokens.name: app-page-staff-resolve
tokens.usage: Maximum inline size of the Hub page that already uses it: O-16. Preserved from the approved prototype (G5).

tokens.name: app-side-nav
tokens.usage: Hub side navigation inline size, shown at and above the Hub breakpoint (G5).

tokens.name: app-aside-staff
tokens.usage: Inline size of the aside on two-column Hub pages (G5).

tokens.name: app-aside-staff-compact
tokens.usage: Inline size of the side column on Hub pages that already use it: O-01, O-12 (G5).

tokens.name: app-page-resident
tokens.usage: Resident desktop shell maximum: the header row, the page and the footer are centred within it (desktop layout approved 2026-10-08; 1120px in the first direction of 2026-10-07).

tokens.name: app-page-reading
tokens.usage: Resident reading and form column maximum; directory and map retain full shell width.

tokens.name: app-side-directory
tokens.usage: Desktop directory filter column.

tokens.name: app-language-sheet
tokens.usage: Maximum desktop language selection sheet width.

tokens.name: app-aside-resident
tokens.usage: Desktop side column of a resident page at the end of the main column: home's Every day, Find help's topics, a provider's place and actions.

tokens.name: app-map-viewport-offset
tokens.usage: Room for the header and the map page's title above the desktop map and its list, which fill the rest of the viewport height.

tokens.name: app-map-min
tokens.usage: Smallest block size of the desktop map and its list, on a short window or with large text.

tokens.name: app-breakpoint-hub
tokens.usage: Hub shell breakpoint, measured against the viewport: below it the side navigation is hidden; at or above it, it is shown. Shell only; page columns use container-hub-two-column-min (G4). Resident pages have no breakpoint; 320, 390 and 768px are test widths.

tokens.name: app-breakpoint-resident-wide
tokens.usage: Resident desktop navigation and directory columns; approved UI/UX direction 2026-10-07.

tokens.name: app-container-hub-two-column-min
tokens.usage: Minimum available content width, inside the page padding, for a two-column Hub page. Below it, main content and aside stack in one column, main first. Not a viewport breakpoint (G4, G5).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Slide containers: feature cards, panels, bands, bars.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Everything you can touch, on every surface (buttons, tags, inputs), plus document and screen containers (ServiceCards, notices).

tokens.name: radius-header
tokens.usage: The one swooping corner (bottom-right) of the PageHeader. Once per page.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Icon discs and portrait crops.
